lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: All right, here we go. OverDrive, cottage edition, night two. CBAY 98.1, the dock, and whoever's phone is loudest. I'm Hayes. That's O'Dog. Noodles is still off. It's a professional show.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Night two, Hayesy. And I want to start with a crime. Friday, Carlisle Golf and Country. Somebody walked out of that clubhouse with a handful of Snickers bars.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: You walked out of that clubhouse with a handful of Snickers bars.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Allegedly. Anyway. The golf. Jay and Chris took a point in the scramble. Then the seven hole scramble, the short one, half a point. Nick and Justin took the high low, one and a half to one. So it's tight going into Saturday.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Then the steak dinner. Here's the thing, O'Dog. There was no steak dinner. Three hour drive up to the cottage, and they stopped at Taco Bell on the way.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Taco Bell. On a three hour drive. To a COTTAGE. With a grill. I really don't understand these guys. You skip the steak for a Crunchwrap and then you sit in a car for two more hours with it. That's not a decision, that's a cry for help.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: The fire was good though. Hot dogs on the fire. Beers. The air had a certain smell to it. And the takes came in. Nine of them on the board by 10 o'clock. We'll get to those.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: And Nick. Tell them about Nick.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Nick crushed a bottle of wine, went in to use the bathroom, and never came back. Found him in his bed. Birthday boy. Down before 11.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: The Captain of the annual tournament, out cold with a bottle of red. Series isn't over yet, Hayesy. Series isn't over yet.
